name: StashXR
summary:
Browse, search, and stream your Stash library right from your headset. StashXR connects to your self-hosted Stash server and puts your entire media collection at your fingertips in a sleek, immersive interface.

Filter by tags, performers, studios. Sort however you like. 
Find exactly what you're looking for in seconds.
Watch your media in flat-screen mode or fully immersive VR/XR.

Features:

- Full search, filter, and sort across your Stash library
- Flat-screen and immersive VR/XR playback modes
